The Chinese characters for Ethan

As a transliteration, Ethan is usually written 伊桑 (Yī sāng). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

Origin and meaning

Ethan comes from Hebrew and means “firm, enduring”.

About the name Ethan

A solid Hebrew name that topped the US charts for most of the 2010s.

As a gift or a tattoo

People often order Ethan as a framed gift or as a tattoo — the meaning, “firm, enduring”, is part of the appeal.
